snippet.title: College Kings 2: Episode 1 [NOW AVAILABLE]
snippet.description:
Welcome to the new era of stunning visuals, immersive sex scenes and a vast, dynamic branching narrative where every choice matters. College Kings 2 improves upon every aspect of its predecessor. Now available from:

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/collegekings
Steam: steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924480/College_Kings_2__Act_I

What you can expect from College Kings 2:
+ Get excited for more content in every release
+ Experience gorgeous graphics and cinematic artwork
+ Shape the story, with more player impact than ever before
+ Be fully immersed in beautiful high-definition animations
+ Feel as if you’re there through all new sex scene voice acting
+ Live out your fantasies with interactive foreplay
+ Combine strategy and satisfying knockouts in the revamped turn-based fight system
+ Come across less bugs with a completely reformed code structure
+ Enjoy fast, stable downloads with small file sizes
+ And for the first time ever, collect College Kings Steam Trading Cards
